R-02 · Fields 6 works · 2026

Constructed perceptual fields. No object, no focal point — depth produced entirely through repetition, compression and the behaviour of light across a black ground.

R-01 · Reflections 6 works · 2025–2026

Chrome forms set against patterned black grounds. The surface carries no colour of its own; what appears is produced by everything around it.
